typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string (),
	LoadDatatotblMSRBtradesReportedLate_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CUSIP as string,
		{B S} as string,
		{Trade Type} as string,
		EBS as string,
		Price as string,
		XREF as string,
		{Trade Date} as string,
		{Settlement Date} as string,
		{Submission Date} as string,
		{Contra Alpha} as string,
		{Contra Full Name} as string,
		{Reason for Late} as string,
		{Group Responsible} as string,
		{Person Responsible} as string,
		Explanation as string,
		{DTC #} as string,
		{Par Value} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FileName = toString(($sFileName)),
		LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of FileName} = FileName) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		contraFullName as string,
		reasonForLate as string,
		groupResponsible as string,
		fileName as string,
		personResponsible as string,
		submissionDate as string,
		tradeDate as string,
		settlementDate as string,
		explanation as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CUSIP as string,
		contraAlpha as string,
		BS as string,
		XREF as string,
		Price as string,
		dtcNumber as string,
		EBS as string,
		ParValue as string,
		tradeType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		contraFullName = {Contra Full Name},
		reasonForLate = {Reason for Late},
		groupResponsible = {Group Responsible},
		fileName = {Copy of FileName},
		personResponsible = {Person Responsible},
		submissionDate = {Submission Date},
		tradeDate = {Trade Date},
		settlementDate = {Settlement Date},
		explanation = Explanation,
		loadDate = LoadDate,
		CUSIP,
		contraAlpha = {Contra Alpha},
		BS = {B S},
		XREF,
		Price,
		dtcNumber = {DTC #},
		EBS,
		ParValue = {Par Value},
		tradeType = {Trade Type}),
	partitionFileNames:[($LoadDatatotblMSRBtradesReportedLate_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> LoadDatatotblMSRBtradesReportedLate
